description: This file is a web page that demonstrates usage of the Leaflet JavaScript library for interactive maps, including map setup, markers, layers, and event handling.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs the event type to the console when a map event occurs.

methods.name: attachMoveEvent
methods.description: Attaches an event listener to the map for movement and zoom events, updating the DOM with the map's center and zoom level.
